evidence.title: Bklit UI - Charts & Data Visualization Components

name: Bklit UI Blocks
summary: Ready-to-go chart blocks for dashboards: compact KPI stat cards with area, line or choropleth sparklines, installed with the shadcn CLI.
description: The Blocks page of Bklit UI, a shadcn/ui chart library. Each block is a compact dashboard card — a KPI stat card with an animated average, a trend badge and an axis-free sparkline — in area chart, line chart and choropleth map variants. Blocks install through the shadcn CLI (@bklit/stat-card-area-01 …) or open directly in v0.
contains: ready-to-go chart blocks for dashboards and analytics
stat cards with animated averages, trend badges and axis-free sparklines
variants: area chart, line chart and choropleth map
blocks can be opened directly in v0
page of Bklit UI (56 catalogued shadcn registry items)
